newsitem.title: USA: CFTC seeks comments on stock futures proposals.
newsitem.headline: CFTC seeks comments on stock futures proposals.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Monday it was seeking public comment on proposals by the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, the Kansas City Board of Trade and the New York Futures Exchange to modify their domestic stock index futures contracts.

The exchanges want to change their opening, intermediate and overall daily price limits in response to a proposal from the New York Stock Exchange to raise the levels of its "circuit breaker" trading-halt triggers.
In a notice in the Federal Register, the CFTC said the deadline for comments is January 14.
